content: वरिष्ठ {%a.%} .²1 Best, most excellent, most distinguished or pre-eminent; अयं च पार्थो बीभत्सुर्वरिष्ठो ज्याविकर्षणे <ls>Mb. 3. 35. 12</ls>. .²2 Largest, greatest. .²3 Widest. .²4 Heaviest. .²5 Worst, most wicked; (<ab>superl.</ab> of उरु <ab>q. v.</ab>). .{@-ष्ठः@} .²1 The francoline partridge. .²2 The orange tree. .{@-ष्ठम्@} .²1 Copper. .²2 Pepper.
